title: Jewel-Smoked Korean Pear Wrap
description: A kid-friendly greek dish featuring a savory pear wrap wrapped in leaf and smoked for a smoky, flaky texture. Perfect as a light meal or snack.

ingredients.name: Leaf Wrapping Vegetables (e.g. Bibb lettuce, endive)

instructions: Core the pears and remove any stems. Rinse them and dry thoroughly.
Wash leaf vegetables, trim ends, and place in a bowl of water to clean and rinse again.
Dress pears with oil, black beans, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper; lightly massage the dressing into pear flesh with your hands.
Place each dressed pear core-side down onto each leaf. Tuck leaves around pears and secure with toothpicks if needed.
Transfer pear-leaf wraps to a baking tray lined with parchment paper or a silicone mat, and bake for 10 minutes.
After 10 mins, remove from oven, sprinkle sesame seeds over each wrap, then return to oven for an additional 4-5 mins until crisp and tender but not burnt.
Serve hot as a snack with a side of yogurt or dipping sauce.
